t.Il nostro criterio, come scegliamo le no: Our criteria: how we choose the news, the sources and the languages
t.La mappa è mondiale per scelta: il BIM n: The map is global by choice: BIM does not belong to one country. The curator's wish is that every organisation, anywhere in the world, can use this technology to build better, and so to improve the lives of those who live, study and work in buildings.
t.Le notizie sul BIM sono tantissime: ogni: There is a huge amount of BIM news: every day the trade press publishes updates on products, courses and company case studies. This review does not collect them all: it is a selection of what can genuinely interest designers and people working in the sector.
t.A parità di interesse, si preferisce la: When interest is equal, we prefer the news that helps someone get started: a free guide, a mandate explained, a first pilot project, a country starting from scratch.
t.Da quali fonti, in ordine di affidabilit: Which sources, in order of reliability
t.Restano sempre fuori blog personali, sit: Always excluded: personal blogs, websites of individual practices or consultants, resellers, local news, social media posts and sites without author or date. Every item is checked by opening its source, and nothing published before 2015 is included.
t.Le lingue in cui cerchiamo le notizie: The languages we search the news in
t.Ogni notizia si cerca nella lingua del p: Each item is searched for in the language of the country where it originates, not only in English.
t.Ogni notizia ha il link alla fonte princ: Every item links to its main source, for those who want to read it in full. When a date or a detail is uncertain, a note says so.
t.Esplora le notizie per luogo, tema e per: Explore the news by place, topic and period with the map, the filters and the archive; the BIM & AI tab collects those dedicated to artificial intelligence. In the left-hand column you will also find upcoming events and webinars.
t.Quando la potenza dell'intelligenza arti: When the power of artificial intelligence meets BIM
t.Un modello BIM è un grande archivio ordi: A BIM model is a large, ordered archive of information: geometry, materials, building services, schedules and costs. Artificial intelligence can read that data and put it to work: it proposes solutions, finds errors and clashes before construction, takes care of repetitive tasks and answers questions in natural language.
t.Insieme possono fare davvero la differen: Together they can really make a difference in construction: more consistent designs, safer sites, buildings that use less energy and are easier to manage, for those who build them and those who live in them. Decisions, however, remain with the people who design and sign.
t.Qui trovi le notizie in cui l'intelligen: Here you will find the news in which artificial intelligence applied to BIM is the main topic, with the same map, filters and archive as BIM News.
t.Date e costi verificati sulle pagine deg: Dates and costs were checked on the organisers' pages when we added them: always check them before registering. Your location stays in your browser and is not sent to anyone.

t.Le ricerche universitarie sul BIM, da le: University research on BIM, readable even without good English: for each article, the title and abstract translated into Italian, the original one click away and a direct link to the publication.
t.Raccogliamo articoli scientifici sul BIM: We collect scientific articles on BIM published in peer-reviewed journals, the same ones you find on Google Scholar or Academia.edu, searching for them in the open metadata archives of publications (Crossref). We only publish open-access articles under the Creative Commons BY licence: it is the licence that allows the abstract to be reproduced and translated, crediting authors and source.
t.Le traduzioni sono nostre: servono ad av: The translations are ours: they are meant to bring the academic world closer to those who do not read English well, but when citing an article the original text always prevails. The Italian translation is offered to those who chose «Whole world» or «Europe» as their area; with another area you start from the original abstract. You can always switch language with the buttons above.
t.Webinar e conferenze registrati e canali: Recorded webinars and conferences, and channels about BIM: all free and available to everyone. We choose them with the same criteria as the review: rules, open standards, procurement, tools and artificial intelligence.
t.Lezioni e conferenze di professori e ric: Lectures and talks by professors and researchers from Stanford, Technion, TU München, Cambridge, UCL, Penn State, Politecnico di Torino, Politecnico di Milano and Sapienza. From MIT and Harvard we have not found, so far, public videos dedicated to BIM on their channels.
t.I video si aprono su YouTube: non li inc: Videos open on YouTube: we do not embed them in the site, so no third-party cookies are loaded until you choose to watch them. The list grows every week along with the review; for subtitles in your language you can use YouTube's automatic translation.
t.Tutto quello che sta per arrivare nel mo: Everything coming up in the BIM world, in one place: regulatory deadlines, in-person events and online webinars. Each entry has a link to the official page, the date and the cost.
t.Obblighi BIM che entrano in vigore, paes: BIM mandates coming into force, country by country.

Online: they can be followed from any country.

Deadlines include the source of the rule or the news. The area you choose here applies to the whole site: you also find it at the top, in the settings bar, and it is saved only in your browser.
t.Le domande che ci si pone esplorando BIM: The questions people ask while exploring BIM News: what you find on the various pages, how we choose the news, which languages we search in, how to use the site.

You will find them in the answers below. Every item includes a link to the original source: for an important decision, always refer to it.

t.Una rassegna settimanale sul BIM (Buildi: A weekly review of BIM (Building Information Modeling, the method of designing and managing buildings and infrastructure with a digital model made of objects that carry their own information). It collects news from all over the world, summarises it in Italian, places it on the map and always includes a link to the source. Alongside the news there is a guide for beginners, translated university research, videos, an agenda and manuals.
t.Devo registrarmi o pagare?: Do I need to register or pay?
t.No. Il sito è gratuito e senza registraz: No. The site is free and requires no registration.

t.Perché sulla mappa alcuni paesi sono anc: Why are some countries still empty on the map?
t.Perché la ricerca non li ha ancora raggi: Because the research has not reached them yet, not because BIM is missing there. A systematic search is under way, area by area, in the language of each country; every week part of the work goes to the countries that are still empty.

t.Quante notizie ci sono per continente, p: How many news items there are per continent, country or region. Tap a continent, then a country and a region to see the news from that place.

t.Sono notizie che abbiamo raccolto più di: They are items we collected more than seven days after they were published, to complete the history of a country or a standard.
t.Perché non ci sono notizie prima del 201: Why is there no news before 2015?
t.Il 2015 è l'anno in cui è uscita la prim: 2015 is the year the first part of UNI 11337, the Italian series of BIM standards, was published. We use it as a common starting point for the whole world.
t.Che cosa trovo in BIM & AI?: What will I find in BIM & AI?
t.Le notizie in cui il tema principale è l: The news in which the main topic is artificial intelligence applied to BIM and construction, with the same map and filters as BIM News.
t.In che lingue cercate le notizie?: Which languages do you search the news in?
t.Cerchiamo ogni notizia nella lingua del: We search for each item in the language of the country where it originates, not only in English. Below you will find the languages we search in and those we are reviewing.
t.Sono le lingue nazionali di paesi in cui: They are the national languages of countries where we expect BIM activity. We search them one by one: if after serious research we find no suitable sources, the language leaves the list; if we find them, it moves to the list above.
t.Come avete scelto queste lingue?: How did you choose these languages?
t.Nel mondo si parlano circa 7.100–7.200 l: Around 7,100–7,200 languages are spoken in the world: that is the order of magnitude given by Ethnologue, the reference catalogue. Only a small share has digital content on technical topics. To measure this we used a public, verifiable indicator: the editions of Wikipedia. Wikipedia has 348 active language editions; the article on artificial intelligence exists in 185, the one on BIM in 38. The languages with an article on BIM (excluding Esperanto, which has no reference country) are the starting point of the research. To these we add, under review, the national languages of the countries where we expect activity. Data collected in November 2026.

We credit them anyway, out of respect for their work. On the site the photos are tinted in each page's colour and appear only in the full version.
t.Non sai cos'è il BIM? Parti da qui: cos': Don't know what BIM is? Start here: what it is, what it is for in a design office, why today you cannot do without it, the standards and the acronyms. Five minutes for the essentials, the rest whenever you like.
t.02 Tutta la vita dell'opera: 02 The whole life of the asset
t.Per secoli il progetto è stato un disegn: For centuries a design was a drawing made by hand: plans, sections and elevations, each drawn separately. Palladio's plate already contains all the ingredients we still use today. This approach stayed the same until the computer arrived: separate views, to be kept consistent by hand.
t.Per allungare il muro si spostano le lin: To lengthen the wall you move the lines, one by one.
t.D.Lgs. 36/2023, art. 43, c. 1, come modi: Legislative Decree 36/2023, art. 43(1), as amended by Legislative Decree 209/2024
t.Dieci anni di norme in una lisca di pesc: Ten years of standards in a fishbone: read it from left to right, from 2015 to today. Tap a milestone to see what it changed; UNI and ISO standards are sold on the official websites, and here you find the direct link.
Where BIM was born and how it reached Italy. Above, the world, from the first idea in 1975 to the ISO standards; below, Italy, from the first coding standard in 2009 to today's mandate. The lines link an Italian standard to the international one it adopts. Tap a milestone for details and sources.
t.Le «dimensioni» dicono quali informazion: The «dimensions» say which information is added to the model beyond geometry. Before 3D there is the two-dimensional CAD drawing (2D). Up to 5D there is agreement everywhere; from 6D the definitions change from country to country, and 8D, 9D and 10D are proposals still under discussion, not standards. That is why in a specification it is better to state which uses and which information are needed, not just a label.
t.Il punto di partenza: un modello tridime: The starting point: a three-dimensional model made of objects (walls, slabs, beams, pipes), each with its own geometry and information. All the other dimensions build on this.
t.Contiene geometria, posizione, materiali: It contains the geometry, position, materials and classification of every object.
t.Piante, sezioni e abachi nascono dallo s: Plans, sections and schedules come from the same model and stay consistent.
t.Le discipline si coordinano e le interfe: The disciplines coordinate and clashes are found before construction.
t.Gli oggetti del modello vengono collegat: The model's objects are linked to the activities in the schedule: you can see how the building grows over time, phase by phase.
t.Microsoft Project e Primavera P6 per il: Microsoft Project and Primavera P6 for the schedule to be linked
t.Simula la sequenza costruttiva e le fasi: It simulates the construction sequence and the work phases.
t.Aiuta a organizzare il cantiere: gru, de: It helps organise the site: cranes, storage, routes, work areas.
It compares planned against actual progress.
t.Alle quantità misurate sugli oggetti si: Price-list items are associated with the quantities measured on the objects: the cost estimate comes from the model and updates with it.
t.Ancora nessuna notizia dedicata nella ra: No dedicated news in the review yet: we will add it when it arrives.
t.Quantità estratte in automatico, non ric: Quantities extracted automatically, not recounted by hand.
t.Stime rapide quando cambiano le scelte d: Quick estimates when design choices change.
t.Base per varianti e stati di avanzamento: A basis for variations and progress valuations.
t.Secondo la nomenclatura della UNI 11337: According to the UNI 11337 nomenclature as reported by BibLus, 6D is the management of the completed asset: use, maintenance, facility management. Note: internationally, 6D often refers to sustainability.
t.Il committente riceve un edificio con le: The client receives a building together with its information: components, warranties, manuals.
t.Manutenzioni programmate a partire dagli: Planned maintenance based on the model's objects.
t.Collegamento con la ISO 19650-3, la fase: Link with ISO 19650-3, the operational phase.
t.Nella nomenclatura italiana la 7D è la v: In the Italian nomenclature, 7D is the assessment of sustainability, environmental, economic and social. Abroad, on the contrary, 7D is often facility management.
t.Analisi energetiche a partire dal modell: Energy analyses based on the model.
t.Quantità di materiali per valutare impat: Material quantities to assess impacts and life cycle.
t.Confronto tra alternative di progetto an: Comparing design alternatives on environmental grounds too.
t.Il termine 8D è stato usato per la prima: The term 8D was first used by Imriyas Kamardeen (2010) for BIM serving accident prevention right from the design stage («prevention through design»). Today it refers to safety throughout the life of the asset.
t.Synchro 4D e Navisworks per simulare le: Synchro 4D and Navisworks to simulate the phases
t.Individuare i rischi già in progetto e p: Identify risks already at the design stage and design them out.
t.Pianificare protezioni, percorsi e aree: Plan protections, routes and site areas on the model.
t.Studiare anche i rischi dell'edificio in: Also study the risks of the building in use, not only of the construction site.
t.La 9D porta nel modello la «lean constru: 9D brings «lean construction» into the model: less waste of time, materials and labour, with a more continuous flow of activities planned together by those who build.
t.Quantità precise per ordinare il materia: Precise quantities to order the right material at the right time.
t.Pianificazione condivisa delle attività: Shared planning of activities between contractors and designers.
t.Meno attese, meno rifacimenti, meno scar: Less waiting, less rework, less waste.
t.La 10D guarda all'industrializzazione de: 10D looks at the industrialisation of construction: designing and producing the building like an industrial product, with components prefabricated off site and assembled in place.
t.Il modello diventa la fonte dei dati per: The model becomes the data source for workshop production.
t.Prefabbricazione e produzione «offsite»,: Prefabrication and «offsite» production, with quality control.
t.Lavorare con formati e standard aperti,: Working with open formats and standards, without depending on a single software.
t.Capitolato informativo: che cosa chiede: Exchange information requirements (in Italian «capitolato informativo», CI): what the client asks for, which information, in what format and when (UNI 11337-5).
t.Livello di sviluppo degli oggetti, da A: Level of development of the objects, from A to G in UNI 11337-4: how fully an object is defined at that stage.
t.Controllo automatico delle interferenze: Automatic check of clashes between the models of the different disciplines.
t.BIM Manager, BIM Coordinator, BIM Specia: BIM Manager, BIM Coordinator, BIM Specialist and CDE Manager: the roles defined by UNI 11337-7.
t.Quanto fa risparmiare davvero il BIM? Qu: How much does BIM really save? Below are the figures from the research we were able to check, each with its source, then a calculator that applies them to your practice. The numbers vary greatly from project to project: read them as orders of magnitude, not as promises.
t.meno tempo per preparare un computo da m: less time to prepare a cost estimate from the model, with estimates accurate to within 3%
t.del valore del contratto risparmiato gra: of contract value saved thanks to clash detection
t.risparmiati con la verifica delle interf: saved through clash detection before construction, on a 35-million-dollar university building
t.a settimana, per persona, perse in canti: per week, per person, lost on site to conflicts, rework and searching for information
t.delle rilavorazioni nei cantieri statuni: of rework on US construction sites stems from poor communication and wrong project data
t.Valore delle opere progettate in un anno: Value of works designed in a year
t.Quota del tempo perso che il BIM fa recu: Share of lost time that BIM recovers
t.Risparmio sul valore delle opere: Saving on the value of the works
t.Come calcoliamo: ore = persone × 14 ore: How we calculate: hours = people × 14 hours a week × 46 weeks × share recovered; saving = value of works × percentage. The initial values are deliberately cautious, below the 10% indicated by Stanford: they are our assumptions, change them with yours.
t.Caffè e notti insonni sono un gioco, non: Coffee and sleepless nights are a game, not a statistic: no study has measured them. The rest of the section, however, comes from the sources cited.
t.Obbligo di usare il BIM non vuol dire ob: A mandate to use BIM does not mean a mandate to be certified. Almost everywhere certification is voluntary: it serves to show a client, through the judgement of a third party, that you can do what you claim. Here is how it works in the countries we have checked, with the rule that governs it and the source.
t.Si certificano le competenze di una figu: The skills of a role are certified, for example BIM Manager or BIM Coordinator: an exam and maintenance over the years. Bodies that certify people are accredited under ISO/IEC 17024.
t.Si certifica che uno studio o un'impresa: It is certified that a practice or a company manages information as required by ISO 19650: an audit of processes and projects, repeated every year.
t.Per le opere pubbliche oltre 30 milioni: For public works above 30 million Hong Kong dollars, the appointed party's BIM team must be led by a BIM Manager certified by the Construction Industry Council (CIC). For tenders from 1 January 2024, BIM Coordinators must also be certified (at least half at full level).
t.DEVB Technical Circular (Works) n. 2/202: DEVB Technical Circular (Works) No. 2/2021 and update of 13/06/2023
t.Il Codice dei contratti chiede alle staz: The Public Contracts Code requires contracting authorities to appoint a common data environment manager, at least one digital process manager and, for each project, an information coordinator, with «adequate competence» acquired through professional practice or courses passed successfully. Certification is not required: it is one way to document competence. The roles are those of UNI 11337-7:2018; the requirements for certifying them are in the reference practice UNI/PdR 78:2020, in force since 2 March 2020.

h.Le novità sul BIM raccolte ogni settiman: BIM news collected every week, each with a summary in Italian and a link to the source. A site curated by Marco Scigliuolo, always a work in progress: the curator updates and expands it whenever needed.
h.Versione essenziale: la mappa interattiv: Essential version: the interactive map (about 380 KB) is not downloaded. You can filter the news with «Geographic area», or
h.È un raccoglitore di informazioni che vu: It is a collection of information that aims to spread BIM culture across the construction world, and also the curator's personal blog: a small library to read and learn.
h.Non è un social network da moderare né u: It is not a social network to moderate, nor a place to post opinions: for discussion, we meet later on LinkedIn ↗.
h.La missione del sito: far conoscere la c: The site's mission: to make BIM culture known to the whole world. The curator's personal mission: to spread it in Italy, a country deeply attached to its traditions, so that BIM is not just a «certificate» for public tenders but a tool deeply tied to the design method. We can't work miracles, but we try to do things properly. We give it a go.
h.Il criterio di fondo è l'inclusività. Qu: The underlying principle is inclusiveness. This site exists so that everyone adopts BIM: not only large clients and big engineering firms, but also the small practice, the local builder, the mountain municipality, the student. That is why the news is written in plain Italian, acronyms are explained, open formats and free resources are preferred, and every country that takes a step forward, however small, finds its place on the map.
h.Norme e obblighi: leggi, decreti e scade: Rules and mandates: laws, decrees and deadlines for public procurement
h.Standard: ISO 19650, UNI 11337, IFC e gl: Standards: ISO 19650, UNI 11337, IFC and the other open formats
h.Strategie nazionali e appalti: piani BIM: National strategies and procurement: government BIM plans, major projects and public works
h.Software e intelligenza artificiale: sol: Software and artificial intelligence: only the updates that change the way we work
h.Eventi di riferimento: fiere, congressi: Key events: trade fairs, conferences and industry awards
h.Fonti istituzionali, sempre ammesse: gov: Institutional sources, always accepted: governments, ministries, official gazettes, standards bodies (ISO, CEN, UNI, DIN and their national equivalents), national buildingSMART chapters, public contracting authorities, universities and development banks. Cities, regions and provinces count only when they make a concrete contribution to BIM: a mandate, a regulation, a model-based building permit, a programme, a major project.
h.Stampa autorevole: testate di settore co: Reputable press: trade publications with an editorial team, major national newspapers, news agencies.
h.Grandi aziende, solo per fatti di peso r: Large companies, only for facts of real weight, such as a major project delivered in BIM; never to present a product.
h.In verifica: lingue nazionali di paesi i: Under review: national languages of countries where we expect BIM activity. They stay on the list if they bring valid sources; otherwise they are removed.
h.Come le abbiamo scelte è spiegato nelle: How we chose them is explained in the frequently asked questions.
h.Lingua. Le notizie sono scritte in itali: Language. The news is written in Italian, with a link to the original source. To read the full text in another language, use your browser's built-in translation.
h.Il sito è gestito dall'ingegner Marco Sc: The site is run by engineer Marco Scigliuolo and is generated with Claude, Anthropic's artificial intelligence assistant. On the The curator page you will find his profile, portfolio, manuals and projects.
h.Tramite LinkedIn ↗. Nota bene: il sito è: Via LinkedIn ↗. Please note: the site is run by one person, so the author is not always able to reply quickly.
h.Per ora no. In questo momento l'autore n: Not for now. At the moment the author does not accept paid collaborations, because the site is run mainly with his Claude Pro plan, and he is not looking for external collaborations on the site. He does, however, accept sponsorships to move to a plan with more tokens, if you want to help expand the site: in that case, let's talk on LinkedIn ↗. The site is a passion, a small hobby: it will continue as long as it is sustainable, both financially and in terms of the time the curator can devote to it.
h.Da tre tipi di fonti. Le fonti istituzio: From three kinds of sources. Institutional sources: governments, ministries, official gazettes, standards bodies, national buildingSMART chapters, contracting authorities, universities, development banks; cities, regions and provinces only when they make a concrete contribution, such as a mandate, a regulation or a major project. Reputable press: trade publications with an editorial team, major national newspapers, news agencies. Large companies, only for facts of real weight and never for advertising. Personal blogs, websites of individual practices, resellers, local news and social media are excluded.
h.Pubblichiamo un fatto quando cambia qual: We publish a fact when it changes something for those who design or build in that country: national strategies and mandates, adopted standards, major public works in BIM, first pilot projects, key events. h.2 Il CAD: le stesse linee, al computer: 2 CAD: the same lines, on a computer
h.Il CAD porta il tavolo da disegno nel co: CAD brings the drawing board into the computer. You still draw lines, more precise, easy to copy and correct. Each line can be given attributes: the layer, the colour, the line type, perhaps a text saying «brick wall». They are labels placed on the drawing that describe it but do not govern it. To lengthen a wall you have to move its lines, and then correct the section, the elevation and the bill of quantities by hand.
h.Prova a muovere i cursori: cambia il par: Try moving the sliders: change the parameter and the wall, the area and the volume update by themselves. Example values
h.Nel BIM non si disegnano più linee, ma o: In BIM you no longer draw lines, but three-dimensional objects: a wall, a slab, a window. Each object is governed by parameters: values such as length, height and thickness, linked to one another by formulas. The volume is not redrawn, it is calculated. What we see on screen is no longer a drawing but a representation of the data: plans, sections and schedules all come from the same model.
h.Le informazioni si estraggono e si inser: Information can be extracted and added. Quantities, areas, volumes and schedules come out of the model; and the data needed for calculations, tenders, construction and maintenance goes into it.
h.Le modifiche sono vive. Se alzi un solai: Changes are live. If you raise a slab or widen a room, plan, sections, areas, volumes and schedules update together. In CAD the same work took hours.
h.Un cambio vale per tutti. Se cambi il ma: One change applies to all. If you change the material of a wall type, all the walls of that type change, throughout the project.
h.Attributo o parametro? L'attributo è un': Attribute or parameter? An attribute is a piece of information attached to an element of the drawing, like the layer or colour of a line: it describes it but does not govern it. A parameter, on the other hand, governs the object: change the value and the shape changes, and with it everything that depends on it.
